messages:
Rina: Quick check-in on social launch plan for next Tue. Need hero image (16:9), 1:1 crop, two caption tracks (bench vs dev), UTMs, and three short engagement replies. Can we land assets + copy by EOD?
Cal: Uploading assets now to `s3://redwood-marketing/launch/1768203030/`  names: hero_16x9_final.png, hero_1x1_final.png, teaser_8s.mp4. Also added a 1:1 still fallback.
Vera: I'll draft two caption tracks. Variant Bench will lead with numbers, Variant Dev will lead with integration + SDKs. Keeping X replies under 140 chars.
Nate: Scheduling preference: LinkedIn 08:15 PT company + Pulse, X thread 09:00 PT main post then replies at +7m / +18m / +30m. Queue will be held until Rina signs off.
QueueBot: Scheduling window reserved Tue 08:00-11:00 PT. Conflict check: none.
Rina: CTA copy: primary "Get early access"; webinar CTA for pinned reply: "Save your seat: redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=launch_1768". HubSpot form -> list `launch_1768`. Webhook -> `#leads-launch`.
Cal: Assets uploaded and README added with alt text + suggested captions. Filenames confirmed.
Vera: Draft micro-replies (Benchmark variant):
- A1: "Which model/seq did you run that on?"
- A2: "Nice numbers 525  can you drop the test config?"
- A3: "Want a quick demo clip?"
Draft micro-replies (Developer variant):
- B1: "How long to integrate end-to-end?"
- B2: "Any SDKs/examples for routing?"
- B3: "Hosted or private options?"
Rina: Shorten replies for X (drop articles), add emoji sparingly. Pin the webinar CTA in reply #1 on X.
Nate: Buffer can't do audience splits. If we want a small A/B, we can post Variant A from company handle to 10% (paid) and Variant B organic, or use partner handles for organic split. Recommend not doing native split to avoid skewed reach.
Rina: Ok let's skip audience split. We'll post Variant B on the partner handle as a boost. Nate, keep the first reply pinned and include the webinar CTA.
HubSpotBot: HubSpot form `hs_launch_1768` created and mapped to list `launch_1768`. Tag rule `source:social_launch_1768` added. Webhook to `#leads-launch` verified.
Cal: Added a tiny GIF fallback `teaser_fallback.gif` for low-bandwidth. Also exported a 1:1 still for LinkedIn.
Vera: Final copies will be posted here by 4:15pm PT for Rina's sign-off. Replies compressed for X.
Rina: Great 44D If no blockers I'll approve at 5pm and Nate will release the queues. After publish, monitor the first 45m, seed retargeting audience if CTR < 1.2% and notify SDRs in `#leads-launch`.
Nate: Roger. I'll watch engagement and toggle retargeting. Slack notify to `#leads-launch` is live.
Rina: Thanks team 4AA let's aim for clear lead flow and tidy analytics (UTM tagging + tagged HubSpot list).
